name: GoFlow2
what_it_is: A high-performance, modular network flow collector written in Go that ingests sFlow v5, NetFlow v5/v9, and IPFIX packets and serializes them into protobuf or JSON for downstream transport (Kafka, file, stdout). It is the entry point of a flow telemetry pipeline; storage, enrichment, and alerting are left to external systems.
components: enricher binary with MaxMind GeoIP ASN/Country support (cmd/enricher)
mapping YAML for custom IPFIX/NetFlow template fields
measurement: Prometheus metrics exposed on HTTP port 8080 (/metrics)
Metrics modules: decoder, producer, receiver, templates (metrics/ directory)
Per-flow fields: bytes, packets, sampling_rate, sequence_num, time_flow_start_ns, time_flow_end_ns, time_received_ns
BGP/routing: src_as, dst_as, as_path, bgp_communities, next_hop, bgp_next_hop
Layer-2/VLAN: src_mac, dst_mac, src_vlan, dst_vlan, vlan_id, etype
Transport: proto, src_port, dst_port, tcp_flags, icmp_type, icmp_code
IP metadata: ip_tos, ip_ttl, ipv6_flow_label, fragment_id, fragment_offset, forwarding_status
configuration: -listen URI flag: scheme sflow://, netflow://, or flow:// with host:port and optional ?count=N for parallel sockets
-transport.file.sep: record separator (empty string for binary streaming)
-mapping mapping.yaml: custom field mappings for exotic IPFIX/NetFlow template fields
-produce raw: enables raw producer mode for protocol debugging
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection mechanism; protocol fuzzing must be done externally by sending malformed UDP packets
DOS protections on sFlow: 32-bit length fields are bounded; limits on records and list items per sample (e.g., AS-Path length)
modes: Stdout/JSON mode (default): human-readable JSON lines on stdout
File mode: JSON written to a log file for log-shipping integrations (Loki, Splunk, Fluentd, GCP Logs)
Kafka+protobuf mode: binary protobuf records sent to Kafka for scalable pipelines
Raw producer mode (-produce raw): emits unprocessed decoded packets as JSON for debugging
Enricher pipeline mode: goflow2 binary output piped into enricher for GeoIP ASN/Country annotation
Multi-socket mode: multiple parallel UDP listeners per protocol via ?count=N URI parameter
constraints: NetFlow v9/IPFIX requires Option Data Sets (sampling rate templates) before flows can be decoded; cold-start delay of several minutes until all templates are received
NetFlow v1, v7, and v8 are not supported (under evaluation)
JSON format is advised only for low-volume consumption; protobuf is required for high-throughput workloads
Kafka partitioning by field requires explicit key configuration in the formatter; default distribution is random
Custom protobuf field IDs must be >= 1000 to avoid conflicts with built-in fields
GoFlow2 is the pipeline entry point only — storage, transport enrichment, aggregation, graphing, and alerting are out of scope and must be provided externally
UDP buffer is fixed at 9000 bytes by default
notable_absences: No built-in aggregation or flow stitching — raw samples only
No web UI or built-in dashboard (Grafana/Kibana provided only via compose examples)
No authentication or TLS on UDP collection endpoints
No native OpenTelemetry export (mentioned as possible extension point only)
No fault injection or traffic generation capability
